name: Pleenk Payment
author: Pleenk

sections.description:
Crypto, CB, SEPA, Swift Payment Gateway with No Fraud for WooCommerce

The Pleenk WooCommerce Payment Plugin allows your WooCommerce store to accept instant payments in crypto and fiat currencies (euros, dollars, etc.) while eliminating the risks of devaluation and fraud. This gateway offers a robust, secure, and simplified platform to manage your payments on a global scale. Our solution ensures security, compliance, transparency, operational efficiency, and zero identity and payment fraud, all while providing a seamless, secure, and instant payment experience for your customers.

With support for fiat currencies (credit cards, SEPA, SWIFT) and major cryptocurrencies (Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, etc.), this plugin enables businesses to manage international transactions without complexity, fraud risk, or compliance concerns.

We mix ID Certification and Instant Payment.

Key Features

  • Crypto and Fiat Payment Support
    • Accept payments in major cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and more.
    • Manage fiat payments (euros, dollars, etc.) via credit cards, SEPA, and SWIFT.
  • Real-Time Value Locking
    • Eliminate the risk of cryptocurrency devaluation by locking the transaction value at the time of payment.
  • Data Privacy
    • Ensure the confidentiality of your users’ personal or banking data during transactions.
  • Advanced Fraud Prevention
    • Protect your business from payment fraud with advanced detection mechanisms.
  • International Coverage
    • Operate confidently in over 100 countries, supporting both fiat and crypto payments.
  • Automated Compliance
    • Integrate AML/KYC/KYB processes to ensure full compliance without additional burden.
  • Identity Certification
    • Integrate Identity Certification through confidential identity verification. With this solution, there are no GDPR concerns as we do not share any personal information. Age certification and insurance to eliminate “friendly fraud” or hard fraud.
  • Human Support for Your Customers
    • Pleenk integrates chat support to assist and reassure your users in using the solution.

Benefits

  • Risk-Free Instant Transactions: Protect your revenue by avoiding cryptocurrency price volatility and fraud risks.
  • Cost Efficiency: Reduce your operational costs by centralizing fiat and crypto payments in one solution.
  • User Trust: Provide a confidential and secure experience for your customers.
  • Rapid Deployment: Integrate the solution in less than 2 weeks.

Geography

Accept and send payments in 100+ countries:

  • Europe: France, Germany, Spain, the UK, and more.
  • Asia: Japan, Singapore, Hong Kong.
  • Americas: USA, Canada, Brazil, Mexico.
  • Africa and Middle East: South Africa, UAE.
  • Oceania: Australia, New Zealand.

Use Cases

  • Content and Gaming Platforms: Accept secure fiat and crypto payments without chargebacks, ensuring fraud prevention and compliance.
  • E-Commerce and Marketplaces: Accept secure fiat and crypto payments, ensuring fraud prevention and compliance.
  • ICOs and Token Sales: Integrate an all-in-one solution (KYC, KYB, LCBFT, CB, wire transfers, and exchanges) for your fiat and crypto transactions without fear of devaluation or fraud.
  • International Payments: Make fast and secure cross-border payments with real-time value locking.

How It Works

  • Simple Integration:
    • Connect your system via our API or a plugin for WordPress/WooCommerce.
  • Real-Time Value Locking:
    • Transactions are immediately converted to fiat or stable assets to avoid cryptocurrency volatility.
  • Secure Processing:
    • All payments are processed with integrated compliance and fraud detection controls.
sections.installation:
Installing The Payment Gateway Plugin

  1. Download the plugin zip file from Pleenk.
  2. Login to your WordPress Admin panel.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  4. Click on the “Upload Plugin” button, then “Choose File” to select the downloaded zip file. Click “Install Now” to upload and install the plugin.
  5. Once installed, click “Activate Plugin”.
  6. Go to WooCommerce settings and click on the “Payment Gateways” tab.
  7. Select the “Pay by Pleenk” sub-tab.
  8. Configure your Pleenk payment settings.

** Configuration **

  • Confidential wallet ID: Enter your Pleenk confidentiality wallet ID related to your store. This information is communicated by Pleenk.
  • Condential Private key: Enter your Pleenk confidentiality private key related to your store. You can refer to (Pleenk documentation)[https://developers.pleenk.com/docs/getting-started#1-generate-a-public–private-key-for-signature-] to generate your private key.
  • Pleenk Public Key: Enter your Pleenk public key related to your store. You can find it on (Pleenk documentation)[https://developers.pleenk.com/docs/signature-verification#pleenk-public-key]

Note on advanced options:

  • Test Mode: Enable this option to use pleenk sandbox and validate your integration. This is intended for testing purposes only.
  • Debug Mode: Enable this option to log transaction details. It is recommended to keep this option turned on for troubleshooting.
sections.faq:
Do I need a merchant account to use the plugin?

Yes. To use this plugin, you need to have a merchant services account with Pleenk. Visit Pleenk and contact sales or support for more information.

What is the cost of the gateway plugin?

This plugin is completely FREE to use.
